package.name: week_7_gz_plugins
package.description: Gazebo (gz-sim) plugins for week 7: gz_model_attacher, a world system that attaches a named link of one model to a named link of another with a fixed joint at runtime, detaches it again, and reports the poses of all models (the barrels that the robots pick up and offload). See the comment at the top of the source file for how to use it.
